extension.summary: Lean enhancements for Estuary MOD V2
extension.description: A small, non-destructive set of enhancements for skin.estuary.modv2 (Estuary MOD V2), built fresh against the Omega release. Reorders the gear Settings menu so Skin Settings sits above Media sources, adds an opt-in info overlay on Settings focus (off by default, toggled in Skin Settings > Extras), and sharpens the navigation wordmark with a crisp high-resolution white logo. Run after installing or updating skin.estuary.modv2. Apply and Restore are both available — original files are backed up once and never overwritten, and Restore reverts every change cleanly.
extension.news: Balance the nav wordmark size with the Kodi mark (the "KODI" cap-height now matches the mark height and is vertically centred, like stock Estuary).
